faqs.q: Gypsum or POP, which is better?
faqs.a: Gypsum is faster, cleaner and gives a uniform finish. POP is better for intricate curves and mouldings. Many designs combine both.
A standard 12x10 ft room usually takes 2–4 days including lighting and painting. Larger or multi-level designs take longer.

faqs.q: How much ceiling height is lost?
faqs.a: Typically 4–6 inches for a single-level ceiling, a little more for cove or multi-level sections.
Yes. PVC or moisture-resistant gypsum boards are recommended for wet and humid areas.

faqs.q: Do you do electrical and lighting work?
faqs.a: Yes. Lights, cove LED strips and wiring are installed along with the ceiling, by the same team.
